Use case: photorealistic-natural. WhiskedAway coastal countryside inn glasshouse, same cream plaster/oak/brass material family as Cuddlecore and hallway references. Gardening/ cosy-living magazine PHOTOGRAPH, real plants and natural untidiness, not CGI or illustration. Full-frame24mm,1.6m eye height, level verticals,f/4, ONE16:9 landscape photo unless explicitly otherwise. Old Victorian LEAN-TO: 1.8m wide ×6.3m long. ONE solid long inn wall in cream #f4efe4 limewash; other THREE sides glass. SINGLE-PITCH glass roof highest at inn wall, lowest at garden side, NOT gabled. Slender timber glazing bars painted soft sage-green, lightly flaking; this green supersedes the white bars in hallway glimpse. Worn terracotta square tile floor, weathered honey timber staging, terracotta pots with pale mineral marks, aged brass #b07f52. Soft spring morning sun, gentle bar shadows, light condensation only high on glass. Some soil crumbs, a few yellow leaves, useful untidiness, keep clear walking/door space. No people/animals/text/labels/numbers/signs/logos/watermarks/plastic pots/modern hoses/sprinklers/electric heaters/screens.
Plant palette ONLY: chamomile (small white daisy flowers yellow domed centers/fine feathery foliage), lavender(silver narrow leaves), lemon balm(soft wrinkled serrated leaves), peppermint(opposite pointed serrated leaves), fennel(feathery tall foliage), culinary ginger and turmeric(deep pots, young lance/broad leaves), echinacea(pointed basal leaves, later-season pink coneflowers), thyme(tiny leaves), culinary sage(gray soft leaves), holy basil(opposite oval leaves), calendula(orange daisy flowers), aloe vera(fleshy toothed rosette), rosemary(woody narrow needles), borage(rough hairy leaves, blue five-point star flowers), hibiscus/roselle(lobed leaves, later red calyces), and passionflower(three-lobed leaves/tendrils trained to roof). No ornamental ivy/ferns/palms or invented plants. Show a seasonal MIX of fresh growth, seedlings and a few early flowers rather than every species flowering together.
